why: About six authorities (ALA twice, ATS, Napa County, Banner Health, FDA) answer the question in part. They name battery packs, car adapters, power stations and generators, and say to talk to your provider. None names a product, gives runtimes or prices, or tests anything. The other results are off-target pages, unreadable PDFs and two niche or affiliate pages that estimate from specs. ChatGPT will lean on the authorities for safety. A page with sourced runtimes and current prices could still get in, since niche pages already did, but it would sit beside those authorities rather than replace them.
